tools.name: explain_finding
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what a VibeRaven finding id means, for example rls_disabled or env_var_drift, or pastes a finding from a VibeRaven 1.6.1 report. Returns what the rule detects in repository files, why it matters, how to fix it and what it does not check, quoted from viberaven.dev with a s

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Use this when the user has a launch question about an AI-built app on Vercel + Supabase, such as Supabase RLS, env vars on Vercel, a Stripe webhook after deploy or a client handoff. Searches the launch guides published on viberaven.dev by keyword and returns up to 5 matches, each with its title, URL

tools.name: launch_checklist
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a manual pre-launch checklist for a Lovable + Supabase app or a Next.js + Supabase app on Vercel. Returns the checklist published on viberaven.dev for that stack with its sources, and the one optional local VibeRaven step (`npx -y viberaven@1.6.1 check`), which is advice

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "search_guides" references sensitive artifacts (env var). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Use this when the user has a launch question about an AI-built app on Vercel + Supabase, such as Supabase RLS, env vars on Vercel, a Stripe webhook after deploy…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_guides · Private data: explain_finding, search_guides · Public sink: search_guides · Destructive: launch_checklist.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_guides · Private data: explain_finding, search_guides · Public sink: search_guides · Destructive: launch_checklist

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
